title: KB Power
subtitle: Armor Builder · Bottoms-Up Gauntlet · Swing Pyramid and Carry

checkIn.question: Bend forward and touch your knees. Any back tightness this morning or yesterday?

tiers.label: Some tightness
tiers.description: Use the Amber loads and swaps.

rules: Block A: if you can't finish a round inside the minute with clean reps, switch to a round every 75 seconds.
Stop any swing set that turns into a squat. If the back speaks during Block C, finish with carries only.
Benchmark: note how many clean Armor Builder rounds you finish. Next time: the same rounds with heavier bells, or 12 rounds at the same bells.

items.name: Goblet prying squat
items.cue: Elbows push the knees out; sway side to side.

items.name: Two-hand swing (hinge check)
items.cue: This is your hinge check. A "Hinge, don't squat" cue or any tightness means switch to Amber.

sections.title: A · Armor Builder
sections.description: Every minute: 2 double cleans, 1 double press, 3 double front squats. Rest for what's left of the minute.

items.name: Double clean
items.cue: Bells land softly in the rack, wrists straight.

items.name: Double press
items.cue: Glutes and abs tight, ribs down, biceps by the ears.

items.name: Double front squat
items.cue: This lift tweaked your back when fatigued. Stay upright; stop the block if form slips.

sections.title: B · Bottoms-Up Gauntlet
sections.description: Right hand: clean, press, lunge without putting the bell down. 15–20 s to shake out. Left hand: the same. Then the bear crawl drag. Rest 60 s.

items.name: Bottoms-up clean
items.cue: Crush the handle so the bell balances upside down.

items.name: Bottoms-up press
items.cue: Slow press. If the bell keeps tipping, finish that side holding it normally.

items.name: Overhead reverse lunge
items.cue: Arm locked, torso tall, step straight back.

items.name: Bear crawl KB drag
items.cue: Hips stay flat; drag the bell under you side to side.

sections.title: C · Swing Pyramid and Carry
sections.description: Swings for the ladder number, straight into a 20 m carry, rest 30–45 s. 45 swings and 5 carries in total.

items.name: Two-hand swing
items.cue: Stand tall, snap the hips. Stop the set if it turns into a squat.

items.name: Double farmer carry
items.cue: Tall posture, shoulders down, slow steps, no swinging bells.

items.name: Dead hang
items.cue: Decompresses the spine after the doubles.
